titles: Creator name first, then a bet or question in plain verbs, and never the result. Add a named guest or celebrity when one exists.
Use 1-2 emoji at the end and keep it under 60 characters. Don't claim more than the clip shows ('Taller Than Everyone').
hooks: Max 6 words, and state what is on the line ('LOSE AND THE STREAM ENDS'). Don't repeat the narrator or the title.
Never ship without a hook and context line (OVl3TBtcYHo and JGopxMMkJo8 did).
clip_picks: Pick moments with a spoken one-line premise: a bet, guess, argument or question. Skip walk-ins, dogs, clinches, boss-fight buildups and tip lectures.
One clip per moment, since four dubstep cuts split the audience. Keep the version with a named guest.
Prioritise Speed and Kai with celebrities, Kai with Rakai or Ray, and Jynxzi rank guessing as a series.
length_and_pacing: Aim for 15-30s, since most breakouts run 11-26s. Start ≤2s before the stake line and end ≤2s after the payoff.
End on the payoff line and cut trailing banter so the clip loops.
posting: Post 1-2 clips a day within hours of the stream, since clips older than a few days get 0-15 views.
Confirm that scheduled clips actually go public. After 48h, judge on 3s retention and Shorts-feed share, and check Studio for limits or duplicate-content flags.

money.why: The channel already makes streamer clips, and N3on is a known campaign. Campaigns pay per view without needing subs or YPP.
money.first_step: Read the N3on campaign rules (allowed sources, length, payout and reporting). Then cut one compliant clip and submit it to see if it is accepted.

money.idea: Affiliate links for gear (headset, mic, capture card)
money.why: Clips that talk about hearing, gaming and streaming match gear audiences, such as the Jynxzi hearing clip.
money.first_step: Join an affiliate program for a gear retailer and put one disclosed link in the description of gaming clips. Check that the channel's rules allow it.

money.why: Fan funding needs 500 subs and Shorts ad revenue needs 1000 subs. Current numbers are 0 subs and 50 views, so this is a later goal.
money.first_step: Track weekly subs and Shorts views against both thresholds. Add a pinned comment asking viewers to subscribe for daily recaps.

money.idea: Sponsor outreach or a long-form compilation channel
money.why: Once the Shorts feed serves clips, weekly 'best moments' compilations of Speed and Kai give sponsors a bigger surface.
money.first_step: Hold off until a clip passes about 10k views. Then test one 8-10 minute compilation of the best moments.

next_actions: Open Studio and check for upload limits, duplicate-content flags, or restrictions, since 0-22 views across 22 clips means the feed is likely not serving them.
Pick moments with a spoken premise, and cut them to 15-30s from the stake line to the payoff.
Re-title and re-hook the next uploads using the better_title and better_hook rules, with the creator first and no outcome in the title.
Post 1-2 clips a day within hours of each stream and check each has a hook and context line before publishing.
Read the N3on campaign terms and submit one compliant clip to start earning before YPP.
